page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. It is provisioned with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The server configuration includes no local storage drives and features no GPU acceleration. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

The hardware configuration of ecs.hfr7.24xlarge targets memory-intensive workloads requiring significant RAM allocation per compute core alongside dedicated high-frequency CPU cores. Because local ephemeral storage is absent, all persistent storage operations rely on external network-attached volumes. The high memory density relative to processing cores supports deployment of large in-memory caching layers, Enterprise Resource Planning systems, and relational databases.
